title: Chimichurri Lamb Chops
description: Griddled lamb chops marinated in a fresh herb chimichurri sauce made with mint, coriander, parsley, lemon and garlic.

ingredients.text: grated zest and half the juice of 1 lemon
½ tsp granulated sweetener or sugar
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
8 lamb chops or cutlets, trimmed of all visible fat

steps: Remove the mint leaves from any tough or woody stalks and place in a food processor or blender along with the coriander and parsley.

Blitz on pulse setting until the herbs are finely chopped. Be careful not to over process as you don’t want them to turn into a puree. Alternatively, you can finely chop them with a sharp knife. Scrape into a bowl and add the lemon zest and juice, red wine vinegar, garlic granules, water and sweetener.
Taste and season with a little salt and pepper if required.
Divide the sauce into two. Take one half and rub liberally onto the lamb chops.
Place them in a bowl, cover and refrigerate for between 1–2 hours.
After marinating time, take the lamb chops out of the fridge and allow 15 minutes for them to reach room temperature.
Spray a griddle pan or heavy-based frying pan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a high heat.
When the pan is hot, add the lamb chops.

Cooking time will vary depending on how thick the chops are and how you like them. We prefer ours medium. You can expect to cook them for between 5 and 7 minutes each side. You may need to cook them in two batches, depending on the size of your pan.
Serve with a little of the remaining sauce drizzled over the top.
